questions.q: A bag has 5 red and 3 blue counters. Two are taken without replacement. Find P(both red).
n(ξ) = 30, n(A) = 18, n(B) = 15 and n(A ∩ B) = 8. Find n(A ∪ B).
questions.why: n(A ∪ B) = 18 + 15 − 8 = 25; the intersection must not be counted twice.

questions.q: n(ξ) = 30, n(A) = 18, n(B) = 15 and n(A ∩ B) = 8. A member of B is chosen. Find the probability it is in A.
questions.why: Given B, the denominator is n(B) = 15, so the answer is 8/15.

questions.q: The probability that a spinner lands on red is 0.35. It is spun 200 times. Find the expected number of reds.
